verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents many Gemini Apps (consumer UI) features—Gems, Connected Apps, Deep Research, Daily Brief, scheduled actions, Notebooks, Gemini Live—with no mention of equivalent API/Vertex endpoints exposing these same capabilities. Community evidence actually points the other way, describing the API/AI Studio surface as fragmented and more restricted (gated temperature, hidden top_k, separate 'Code Assist' tiers), reinforcing a UI/API capability gap rather than parity.
